description: Solve a PerimeterX/HUMAN "Press & Hold" challenge on the current page (opt-in). PerimeterX is a BEHAVIOURAL challenge -- the user must press AND HOLD a button for several seconds while the detector measures hold duration, natural hand-tremor, and release timing. It is NOT token-based, so there is no provider to call: the only solution is a real humanized press->hold->release gesture, which this tool emits via CDP Input events (Gaussian-randomized ~3-7s hold with +/-1-2px micro-jitter while the button is held). Auto-locates the #px-captcha widget (or pass an explicit selector). Returns JSON with solved status, hold_ms, and attempts. Use this when browser_friction/captcha-check reports a 'perimeterx' type.

selector.description: Optional CSS selector for the hold target. If omitted, auto-finds the px-captcha button.

name: browser_press_hold
